title: Shared definitions
description: Definitions shared by the package file schemas.

packageId.description: Package ID: upper-case letters and digits, starting with a letter.

localName.description: Name of a table, domain, field or foreign key as written in a package.

reference.description: Reference to a table or domain. Kernel objects carry the kernel namespace, e.g. /RT/TENANTS.

field.description: A field of a table or an extension.

notNull.description: Whether the field rejects NULL. Primary key fields are always NOT NULL.

default.description: Default value. Strings for CHAR, STRING, DATE, TIMESTAMP, UUID and DEC; integers for INT4 and INT8; booleans for BOOL.

foreignKey.description: A foreign key referencing the complete primary key of a target table.

fields.description: Mapping of local fields to key fields of the target table. The tenant field is added automatically.
